description: SessionStart nudge directing the agent to delegate data-engineering tasks to altimate-code via the altimate-code skill, and workspace rules for a project linked to an Altimate workspace: the team rules at session start, corrections recorded on prompt submit, and the post-turn check after each turn (the last two in the background). The old UserPromptSubmit pre-run hook stays removed: it double-invoked altimate-code (once at hook time, once when the model fired the skill), doubling token consumption on the altimate-gateway without improving delegation rate. The workspace-rules prompt hook runs no agent and no model call.
